goal: Extract the cohesive submission-related forwarding API from JPlagOptions so that submission configuration access is modularized separately.

ops.details: Extract the submission-related methods getBaseCodeSubmissionName(), getExcludedFiles(), getExclusionFileName(), getSubmissionDirectories(), getOldSubmissionDirectories(), getSubdirectoryName(), hasBaseCode(), setBaseCodeSubmissionName(String), setExcludedFiles(Set<String>), setExclusionFileName(String), setSubmissionDirectories(List<String>), setOldSubmissionDirectories(List<String>), and setSubdirectoryName(String), together with their required submissionOptions dependency.
Update callers to use the extracted submission option access class or the existing JPlagSubmissionOptions instance instead of the removed forwarding methods on JPlagOptions.
